import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns

# Load the dataset
coffee_sales = pd.read_csv('data/coffee_sales.csv')

# Convert 'date' column to datetime format
coffee_sales['date'] = pd.to_datetime(coffee_sales['date'])

# Aggregate data for visualization
sales_by_date = coffee_sales.groupby('date')['total'].sum().reset_index()

# Set the style of seaborn
sns.set(style='whitegrid')

# Create the plot
plt.figure(figsize=(12, 6))
sns.lineplot(data=sales_by_date, x='date', y='total', marker='o', color='b', label='Total Sales')

# Customize the plot
plt.title('Daily Total Sales in the Coffee Shop', fontsize=16)
plt.xlabel('Date', fontsize=12)
plt.ylabel('Total Sales ($)', fontsize=12)
plt.xticks(rotation=45)
plt.legend(title='Legend', fontsize=10)
plt.tight_layout()

# Save the plot
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
